faqs.question: Are consultations free?
faqs.answer: Yes, consultations are completely free and carry no obligation.

faqs.question: How do I book?
faqs.answer: You can book via WhatsApp or through our website. Please note that we require 24 hours notice for cancellations.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We're open Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 7 PM. We're closed on Sundays.

faqs.question: Do you accept walk-ins?
faqs.answer: We don't accept walk-ins — all appointments need to be booked in advance via WhatsApp or our website.
